name: Maive
text: Maive, sometimes written Maev, is an anglicization of Medb, the great queen-figure of the Ulster Cycle. Readers who meet either spelling in translated sources should follow the main entry under Medb.

attributes.attribute: is the queen-figure of the Ulster Cycle

key_results: Anglicization of Medb, with the variant Maev
